lines: But you're the one wishing for what you don't have
What do you want? Tell me
Looking over there, looking this way
So you like pretty girls, huh
You're the one who thought the waiter
at that café just now was cute, right? Answer me
Swaying, swaying, swaying, like a milkweed seed
You haven't been listening this whole time, have you
That donut shop over there opens next week
And I was planning for us to go together
I was going to take you there, too
Swaying, swaying, swaying, like cigarette smoke
Swaying, swaying, swaying, my heart and
Swaying, swaying, swaying, your heart and
